title: TRICARE Prime Delinquency Letters and Disenrollment for Nonpayment
content:
When a **TRICARE Prime** enrollment-fee installment is not paid by its due date, a delinquency letter is issued on the tier's delinquency notice day after the due date.

## Time condition

The enrollment is disenrolled for nonpayment only once more than the tier's grace days have passed since the due date of the oldest unpaid installment. The grace period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the due date (the first day of the coverage period of that installment), so disenrollment may be processed from the day after the due date plus the grace days and not on that day itself.

- The clock starts from the due date of the oldest unpaid installment on the enrollment's fee account, which is the first day of that installment's coverage period.
- A payment received inside the grace period cures the delinquency.

## Effect of the disenrollment

- The disenrollment takes effect on the enrollment's **paid-through date**, not on the processing date, and claims for later dates of service are denied. The paid-through date is the latest last day of coverage among the enrollment's installment charges that are fully settled by payments posted against them.
- Every family member whose Prime enrollment relies on the same fee-bearing enrollment is disenrolled together.
- A beneficiary disenrolled for nonpayment may enroll again at the next open season or after a new qualifying life event, or ask for an Enrollment Reinstatement Review within the tier's reinstatement request window.

## Figures by tier

| Tier | Grace days after the due date | Delinquency letter issued on day |
|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member | 0 (fee-exempt) | 0 (fee-exempt) |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Service Member | 0 (fee-exempt) | 0 (fee-exempt) |
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Family Member | 0 (fee-exempt) | 0 (fee-exempt) |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Family Member | 0 (fee-exempt) | 0 (fee-exempt) |
| TRICARE Prime Transitional Survivor | 0 (fee-exempt) | 0 (fee-exempt) |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A | 30 | 10 |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B | 30 | 10 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, 30 grace days)

| Oldest unpaid installment due | Processing date | Days passed since the due date | Disenrollment may be processed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 April | 11 April | 10 | no - the delinquency letter is issued on this day |
| 1 April | 1 May | 30 | no - due date plus 30 days, the day itself |
| 1 April | 2 May | 31 | yes |

**Worked effect (hypothetical).** Monthly installments through March are fully settled and the April installment is unpaid. Disenrollment processed on 2 May takes effect on 31 March, the paid-through date, and claims for April dates of service are denied.
